$comment: REGISTERED CANDIDATE in methods/ttha/schemas + schema_contracts._STAGE_SCHEMA_FILES. Do NOT overload EditManifest / slow_edit_v1 / propose_edit. Stage=prep_menu_rank via TTHASlowAgent.propose_prep_rank. Compatible with validate_local_schema (no `not` keyword; hard-reject of edit_manifest via additionalProperties:false + Python post-validator). Design record: docs/design/SLOW_PREP_RANK_V1.md (research pack historically under _scratch/...; gitignored).
title: slow_prep_rank_v1 — Slow prep-menu ranking (registered candidate)

role.description: Agent role; always slow for this stage.

ordered_prep_keys.description: Ordered prep labels from M_large. Index 0 = highest explore priority when a consumer walks in order. Schema allows min/max; post-validator enforces length == allowlist_binding.k, distinct, ⊆ allowlist. When H1 is applied (apply_h1=True), reserved Fixed-div simples are merged as a prefix (forced + fill); see docs/design/SLOW_PREP_RANK_V1.md.

rationale.description: Optional rationale over allowlisted prep labels and held-in C_A/C_B signals; never gated on E.

form_signals_used.description: Which signals informed the ranking. C_B remains in the enum as the research C_B-safe held-in delayed-calibration utility (not deploy E); see docs/design/SLOW_PREP_RANK_V1.md.

abstain.description: If true, research adapter treats as non-ok (no shortlist).

allowlist_binding.description: Bind ranking to a frozen M_large identity + fit budget k. Post-validator requires m_large_id and/or m_large_sha256 present and matching the concrete allowlist.

m_large_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of ordered M_large label list.

k.description: Fit budget; post-validator requires len(ordered_prep_keys)==k when abstain=false.

form_memory.description: Prep-rank signals: pick/family plus held-in C_A/C_B. C_B is held-in delayed-calibration block utility used by the research C_B-safe gate; it is NOT deploy E / held-out test utility. Do NOT call C_B a pure form-only signal — sealed multi-arm feedback accounting is still TBD (see docs/design/SLOW_PREP_RANK_V1.md / §6.28.4 concern). HARD: no E. additionalProperties:false rejects E.

C_A.description: Held-in formation-block utility signal (research prior; not deploy E).

C_B.description: Held-in delayed-calibration block utility for research C_B-safe gates; not deploy E. Information role vs sealed multi-arm feedback accounting: see docs/design/SLOW_PREP_RANK_V1.md / §6.28.4 concern.

non_claims.description: Optional honesty tags, e.g. not_edit_manifest, not_sealed_propose_edit.
